create_layout_visualizer: create a LayoutVisualizer instance to visualize DoclingDocument page layouts with bounding boxes and labels
get_visualization_doc: get_visualization returns a dict mapping page numbers to PIL Images with drawn layout clusters and labels
draw_clusters_on_image: draw_clusters draws colored rectangles and labels for document layout clusters onto a PIL Image
draw_doc_layout_pages: draw_doc_layout iterates DoclingDocument items and draws layout clusters per page onto images
configure_visualizer_params: configure LayoutVisualizer.Params to control show_label and content_layers filtering for visualization
